note: upstream_ids are the NFRs this record adds (NFR20-NFR23); the product's base NFRs NFR1-NFR17 live in the prior record 261016-shikhokplus-tuition-app and are not derivable from this record's requirements.md. NFRx.y IDs are GLOBAL across units, not unit-scoped like BRx.y, so this unit's derived IDs start above the high-water mark each base had reached in the four merged units (NFR6 from .20, NFR7 from .5, NFR10 from .13, NFR12 from .3, NFR13 from .4, NFR14 from .22). A first draft numbered from .1 per base and collided with seventeen existing IDs carrying unrelated meanings; the architecture review caught it and the numbering was corrected before approval. A bare NFR6.1 or NFR12.1 in these artifacts is a citation of the prior record's rule, not a definition here. Five derived blocks have no base NFR in any record and are unit-invented: NFR18.x availability, NFR19.x migration and transactional safety, NFR24.x logging, NFR25.x alerting, NFR26.x SLI/SLO. They are declared in the reverse array with the source that motivates each, because the product's inception NFRs stop at NFR23 and no upstream ID would carry them; declaring them is what keeps them from reading as requirements nobody traced.

reverse.target: team Deployment practice - D1 states no availability target of its own and inherits the product's Phase 1 posture. No inception NFR covers availability; NFR18 has no base entry in either record
team Deployment practice - production deploys scheduled outside Bangladesh classroom hours. A standing operational practice rather than a requirement of this unit
team Deployment practice - forward-only backward-compatible migration run as a distinct logged step. No inception NFR covers migration mechanics
ADR-013 and functional-spec.md section 5 - the conditional backfill. Anchored in a domain-design decision rather than an NFR
team Deployment practice - a verified pg_dump to S3 precedes any production migration, with object existence and size asserted
team Deployment practice - staging exists in Phase 1 so a migration is rehearsed before it touches real teacher and child data
BR3.3 and BR4.1 - account, profile and the optional owner row in one transaction. A functional rule given a reliability target here
BR4.3 - the account is created before the code is sent, so a gateway failure leaves a real account rather than a failure to exist
BR6.1 - no D1 write path resets a decision column. A functional rule restated as a transactional obligation
team Deployment practice - no log line carries a phone number, OTP, token, address or self-authored name. Extends an existing rule to the two new personal fields
app/audit/log.py - the correlation id ties a row to a request without carrying its contents
team Deployment practice - gateway request bodies are never logged at any level, because the OTP is in the body
team Deployment practice - exception tracebacks are never returned to a client. Signup is unauthenticated, so its tracebacks would reach the public
app/auth/ceilings.py fire_ceiling_alert - the global daily ceiling alerts because it is money and the signal of an active attack
app/auth/ceilings.py - narrow ceilings deliberately do NOT alert, because they fire constantly once the product has users and would train the operator to ignore the channel
app/audit/log.py - the fail-open audit component is suppressible by causing write failures, so the failure must alert
team Deployment practice - a failed pre-migration backup alerts, since an unverified upload is not a backup
BR2.1 and BR4.4 - signup attempts countable by outcome with refusals distinguishable by cause. A dashboard obligation with no inception anchor
BR5.2 - the decline rate is the product's feedback on teacher data-entry quality, which is the exposure this unit exists to close
FR1.9e - a seat pending indefinitely is expected, so a rising pending population rather than its existence is the signal
OC-5 - signup success rate measured through the closed-testing pilot with no V1 target, because a percentage set now would be derived from nothing
BR1.1 - accounts holding only unaccepted links that resolve a role lens, target zero, discharged by the adversarial test rather than by a monitor
